stressFacts: You are not alone. Every small task you complete is a real sign of recovery.
Taking small steps is still moving forward. A steady pace matters more than speed.
When the body settles, the mind follows. Give yourself a little more time.
A simple task completed fully is often far more effective than pushing yourself too hard.
